about: The intake for test example 1 (leave requests), package J1. Questions, options and recommendations are docs/spec/B2-question-bank.md (version 1), word for word: `bank_options` and `recommendation` are B2's two table cells as written. The Arabic is Claude Code's translation (docs/arabic-wording-list.md), not checked by an Arabic reader. The answer sheet (`sheet`) is B2's worked mapping for example 1, which B5 ('How it runs here') names as example 1's answer sheet; where the mapping is silent, the sheet follows the app spec src/spec/examples/example-1-leave-request.json, and its `note` says so.

questions.question: What does this replace?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي سيحلّ هذا التطبيق محلّه؟
questions.bank_options: Email or chat threads · A spreadsheet · A paper or PDF form · Nothing, it is new · Something else
questions.recommendation: None; their call

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "Replaces email".

questions.question: Who feels the pain today?
questions.bank_options: The people who submit · The people who approve · The person who reports on it · All three
options: The person who reports on it
questions.recommendation: None; their call

sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent; the app spec names submitters, approvers and reporters.

questions.question: How many kinds of user?
questions.bank_options: One (everyone does the same thing) · Two (someone submits, someone approves) · Three (plus an admin who sees everything) · More
options: Three (plus an admin who sees everything)
options_ar: ثلاثة (إضافةً إلى مسؤول يرى كل شيء)
questions.recommendation: R: Two or three. Reason: builds reliably (H); more roles rarely needed for version one

mark.reason: builds reliably (H); more roles rarely needed for version one
mark.reason_ar: يُبنى بشكل موثوق (لم يُقَس بعد)؛ نادراً ما تحتاج النسخة الأولى إلى أدوار أكثر

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "three roles (employee, manager, HR admin)".

questions.question: Who can see other people's records?
questions.bank_options: Only their own · Their team's · Everyone's, for admins only · Everyone's, for all
questions.recommendation: R: Own, team for managers, all for admin. Reason: satisfies rule 5

mark.text: Own, team for managers, all for admin
mark.text_ar: سجلاته، وسجلات الفريق للمديرين، وكل السجلات للمسؤول

sheet.something_else: Own, team for managers, all for admin
sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent. The app spec gives the recommendation (employee own, manager team, HR admin all), which is not one of the four options, so the scripted customer gives it through "something else"; it is logged as a sign that an option is missing.

questions.question: How do users sign in?
questions.bank_options: Company email (SSO) · Email and password · A shared link, no login
questions.recommendation: R: Company email. Reason: satisfies rule 5; rule 7. See B7 for Stage 1

mark.reason: satisfies rule 5; rule 7. See B7 for Stage 1
mark.reason_ar: يحقق القاعدة 5؛ القاعدة 7. انظر B7 للمرحلة الأولى

sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent. The app spec lists company email sign-in (single sign-on) on its Later list and builds with email and password, as B7 item 5 says for Stage 1.

questions.question: Where does the starting data come from?
questions.bank_options: Typed in by users · Uploaded once from a spreadsheet · Synced from a spreadsheet on a schedule · Connected to another system
options: Synced from a spreadsheet on a schedule
options_ar: تُرفع مرة واحدة من جدول بيانات
تُزامَن من جدول بيانات وفق جدول زمني
questions.recommendation: R: Uploaded once, or synced if it changes weekly. Reason: builds reliably (H); live connections go to Later

mark.text: Uploaded once, or synced if it changes weekly
mark.text_ar: تُرفع مرة واحدة، أو تُزامَن إن كانت تتغير أسبوعياً
mark.reason: builds reliably (H); live connections go to Later
mark.reason_ar: يُبنى بشكل موثوق (لم يُقَس بعد)؛ الاتصالات المباشرة تُنقل إلى قائمة «لاحقاً»

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "data typed in, employee list uploaded once"; the starting data is the employee list.

questions.question: For each record, which fields matter?
questions.bank_options: Shown as a checklist from the example's typical fields; customer ticks and adds
questions.options_ar_note: تُعرض كقائمة اختيار من الحقول المعتادة للمثال؛ يختار العميل ويضيف
questions.recommendation: None; their call. The analyst proposes the typical list from the pattern

sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent; the scripted customer ticks every field of the app spec.

questions.question: Does any field hold personal or sensitive data?
questions.question_ar: هل يحتوي أي حقل على بيانات شخصية أو حساسة؟
questions.bank_options: No · Yes, contact details · Yes, salary, ID or health
options_ar: نعم، الراتب أو الهوية أو الصحة
questions.recommendation: If yes: adds rule 5 and 7 checks and flags hosting inside the country as required

mark.text_ar: إن كانت الإجابة نعم: تُضاف فحوص القاعدتين 5 و7، ويُعلَّم أن الاستضافة داخل الدولة مطلوبة

sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent; the app spec marks the full name and work email as contact details.

questions.question: What does a submitter need to see?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يحتاج مقدّم الطلب أن يرى؟
questions.bank_options: My items and their status · Plus a form to add one · Plus history
options: Plus a form to add one
questions.recommendation: R: My items plus form. Reason: builds reliably (H)

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "screens: my requests"; the app spec adds the form.

questions.question: What does an approver need to see?
questions.bank_options: A queue of items waiting for me · Plus my team's history · Plus totals
options: A queue of items waiting for me
questions.recommendation: R: Queue plus history. Reason: builds reliably (H)

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "team queue"; the app spec's team queue shows the team's history too.

questions.question: What does the admin or reporter need?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يحتاج المسؤول أو معدّ التقارير؟
questions.bank_options: Everything in a table with filters · Plus charts · Plus export
options: Everything in a table with filters
options_ar: كل شيء في جدول مع عوامل تصفية
questions.recommendation: R: Table with filters and export. Reason: satisfies rule 9; charts to Later unless the purpose is a dashboard

mark.reason: satisfies rule 9; charts to Later unless the purpose is a dashboard
mark.reason_ar: يحقق القاعدة 9؛ الرسوم البيانية إلى قائمة «لاحقاً» ما لم يكن الغرض لوحة معلومات

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "HR table"; the app spec's table has filters and an export.

questions.question: When someone submits, who is told?
questions.question_ar: عندما يقدّم أحدهم طلباً، من يُبلَّغ؟
questions.bank_options: Nobody · The approver by email · The approver in the app only · Both
options: The approver in the app only
questions.recommendation: R: Approver by email and in app. Reason: builds reliably (H)

mark.text: Approver by email and in app

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "submit notifies manager"; the app spec notifies by email and in the app.

questions.question: When something is approved or rejected, what changes?
questions.question_ar: عند الموافقة على شيء أو رفضه، ما الذي يتغير؟
questions.bank_options: Only the status · Status plus a balance or count · Status plus a notification · All
options: Status plus a balance or count
options_ar: الحالة إضافةً إلى رصيد أو عدد
questions.recommendation: None; their call. The analyst lists what the example usually changes

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "approve updates balance and notifies employee".

questions.question: Can a submitter edit or withdraw after submitting?
questions.question_ar: هل يستطيع مقدّم الطلب تعديله أو سحبه بعد تقديمه؟
questions.bank_options: No · Yes, until it is approved · Yes, any time
options_ar: نعم، إلى أن تتم الموافقة عليه
questions.recommendation: R: Until approved. Reason: satisfies rule 6

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "withdraw until approved".

questions.question: Who approves?
questions.bank_options: Direct manager · A named person · Manager then a second person · Nobody
questions.recommendation: None; their call

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "approver: direct manager (their call)".

questions.question: Is there a limit or threshold?
questions.bank_options: No · Yes, a number per person · Yes, a number per period · Yes, an amount that changes the approver
options: Yes, an amount that changes the approver
questions.recommendation: None; their call

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "threshold: annual balance (their call)"; the app spec's rule is each employee's annual leave balance.

questions.question: What happens if a rule is broken?
questions.bank_options: Block it and say why · Allow it and flag it · Send it to a second approver
options: Send it to a second approver
options_ar: يُسمح به مع وضع علامة عليه
questions.recommendation: R: Block and say why. Reason: satisfies rule 1

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "over-balance blocks and says why".

questions.question: What must never happen?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يجب ألا يحدث أبداً؟
questions.bank_options: Open text, one line
questions.recommendation: None; recorded verbatim

sheet.open_text: A balance goes negative, or a request is approved by someone other than the employee's manager.
sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent; the app spec's "must never happen", word for word.

questions.question: How will you know it works?
questions.bank_options: I will walk one real case through it end to end · The numbers match my spreadsheet · My team uses it for a week without asking me
options: I will walk one real case through it end to end
My team uses it for a week without asking me
options_ar: سأمرّر حالة حقيقية واحدة عبره من البداية إلى النهاية
يستخدمه فريقي أسبوعاً دون أن يسألني
questions.recommendation: R: One real case end to end, written as steps. Reason: it becomes the acceptance test directly

mark.text: One real case end to end, written as steps
mark.text_ar: حالة حقيقية واحدة من البداية إلى النهاية، مكتوبة كخطوات
mark.reason: it becomes the acceptance test directly

sheet.note: B2's mapping: "done: one employee submits five days, manager approves, balance drops by five, HR sees it" (made-up data only in Stage 1).

questions.question: Who signs off?
questions.bank_options: Me · Me and the approver · Me, the approver and one submitter
options: Me, the approver and one submitter
questions.recommendation: R: Me, the approver and one submitter. Reason: each role tests their own screen

mark.text: Me, the approver and one submitter
mark.reason: each role tests their own screen

sheet.note: B2's mapping is silent; the app spec's sign-off is the HR admin, the manager and the employee.
